title: The autorouter file of a board whose pour has two cutouts and whose outline has an opening
how: The board is the small board of CORPUS-ROUTE-001 with an opening in the outline and two cutouts in its pour; the counts of the file are the same: 2 copper layers, 2 components, 6 pads, 1 net, 4 padstacks, 1 track and 2 vias;
the pour is on the bottom layer and holds 2 cutouts with 3 points each, and Specctra has no hole in a plane, so each is written as a keep-out area of that layer = 2 cutouts of zones;
the opening of the outline is written as a keep-out area on every layer and is not a cutout of a zone.
